name: agent-fleet
description: Rules for multi-agent work, with a UserPromptSubmit hook that injects them whenever the prompt contains 'ultracode' or 'deep-research' (a substring match: measured 2026-08-20, it fires on 4 of 4 invocations and on 8 of 8 prompts that only mention them; records under bench/results/2026-08-20-hook-grep-CLAIMS.md) — the description alone barely fires (measured 2026-08-06: 2 of 30 should-trigger runs, per-query recall 0.00-0.33; no rewrite improved the held-out score; 0 false fires in 150 negative runs; records under bench/results/2026-08-06-trigger-eval/).
